tools.description: List the benchmark and validation cases shipped with rcfd and the built-in case templates.
tools.name: list_cases

tools.description: Create a simulation session from a template, TOML text, a settings object or a case file. Returns the session id and makes it the default session.

path.description: path of a .toml/.json case file inside the sandbox

tools.name: create_case

tools.description: Set one setting by dotted path, e.g. solver.alpha_u or boundaries.lid.velocity_value. Named entries (boundaries.<patch>, reports.<name>) are created on demand. Refused while a run is active.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: set_setting

tools.description: Read one setting by dotted path, or the whole settings tree when path is omitted.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: get_setting

tools.description: Use a mesh file (Gmsh .msh or an OpenFOAM polyMesh directory) instead of a generator.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: load_mesh

tools.description: Build the mesh and return its quality report (non-orthogonality, skewness, aspect ratio, errors, warnings) and patch list.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: check_mesh

tools.description: Start the solver and wait up to wait_seconds for it to finish. Returns the run state; a run that is still going keeps running in the background (poll with status).

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: run

tools.description: Run state, iteration, time, latest residuals and report values.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: status

tools.description: Monitor histories (res_u, res_p, continuity and report values) as x/y arrays; use since to fetch only newer samples.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: get_residuals

tools.description: Min, max, mean and volume average of a field (ux, uy, uz, p, speed, ...).

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: get_field_stats

tools.description: Write the current solution as a VTK .vtu file inside the sandbox and return its path.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: export_vtk

tools.description: List the tasks of the session's set-up/run workflow with their state (not_run, done, failed, stale), dependencies and the next task to run; also lists the available templates and task kinds.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: list_workflow_tasks

tools.description: Create the session's workflow from a template (mesh_to_results, channel_flow, empty), from a workflow document, or by loading a workflow file from the sandbox.

path.description: workflow JSON file inside the sandbox

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: create_workflow

tools.description: Insert a task into, or delete a task from, the session's workflow. Deleting is refused while other tasks depend on the task; inserting validates ids, kinds, dependencies and cycles.

after.description: for insert: id of the task to insert after (default: at the end)

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

task.description: for insert: {id, kind, title?, deps?, params?}

tools.name: edit_workflow

tools.description: Run one workflow task (and, by default, the prerequisite tasks that are not done), or all outstanding tasks when task is omitted. Stops at the first failing task and reports its message. Solve tasks run synchronously under the service limits.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: run_workflow_task

tools.description: Check a case without running it (the --check-only launch): settings, simulation set-up and mesh quality. Give a session, or a case file path inside the sandbox. Returns the exit code the CLI would use (0 ok, 3 invalid, 4 bad mesh).

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: check_case_headless

tools.description: Run the session under the run-control contract: step and wall-clock limits, stop file, continue from a checkpoint, periodic/final checkpoints and a machine-readable status stream written to a file. Blocks until the run ends; returns the outcome (state, exit code, iterations) and the last status events.

interpolate_case.description: case file of the source mesh; with interpolate_checkpoint, initialise from that solution (F-115)

interpolate_checkpoint.description: checkpoint written for the source case

out_dir.description: write solution.vtu, monitors and report.html here at the end

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

status_path.description: write the JSON-lines status stream here

tools.name: run_headless

tools.description: Summarise a status stream file (JSON lines, format rcfd-status) written by `rcfd run --status-json/--status-file` or run_headless: final state, exit code, iterations, last residuals, checkpoints and warnings.
tools.name: read_status_stream

tools.description: Define a design study in a directory inside the sandbox (writes study.json): named parameters with bounds mapped to settings paths, operating conditions, objectives with robust mode (mean, worst, mean_plus_k_sigma, weighted), constraints and a sampler or optimiser (factorial, lhs, sobol, nelder_mead, differential_evolution). The base case is a case file or the settings of a session.

base.description: base case file inside the sandbox

chain.description: start each condition from the previous converged one (default true)

conditions.description: {label, set:{settings path: value}}; default one condition 'base'

dir.description: study directory (study.json and evaluations.jsonl live here)

method.description: {type, budget?, restarts?, seed?, pop?, levels?, n?}

objectives.description: {metric, sense: min|max, weight?, robust?, k?, weights?}

parameters.description: {name, lo, hi, init?, path | targets:[{path, scale?, offset?}]}

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: design_create_study

tools.description: Write a variant case file: a base case file, or a study with parameter values, plus settings overrides, validated through the settings tree. Returns the file path and the settings fingerprint. Refuses to replace an existing file unless overwrite is true.

path.description: variant case file to write (.toml or .json)

tools.name: design_create_variant

tools.description: Run an operating map: points over settings values (grid of axes, or an explicit list), each restarting from the previous converged solution; writes map.csv and map.json to out_dir and returns per-point status, restart kind, iterations and all report values. A repeated identical call returns the stored table without running. Bounded by max_design_evaluations.

axes.description: {path, values} or {path, start, stop, count}; first axis slowest

dir.description: study directory (instead of base) with params for a variant

tools.name: design_run_operating_map

tools.description: Run the study's sampler or optimiser with the case solver, appending every evaluation to the study store; stops after max_evaluations new evaluations (bounded by max_design_evaluations) and continues from the store on the next call. Returns the best record and the Pareto front.
tools.name: design_run_study

tools.description: Evaluate one candidate of a study (all its operating conditions) with the case solver and store the result; a candidate already in the store is returned without running.
tools.name: design_evaluate

tools.description: Record metrics computed elsewhere (for example by running the case through the other tools) for a candidate of a study. Metric values must be finite numbers; give metrics for a single-condition study or conditions [{label, metrics}] for several.
tools.name: design_record

tools.description: Metrics of one stored evaluation of a study (by record index or exact parameter values), or the table of an operating map (map_dir).
tools.name: design_get_metrics

tools.description: Compare stored evaluations of a study side by side: parameters, metrics per condition, exact metric differences against the first record and a ranking by the study objective (feasible first).
tools.name: design_compare_variants

tools.description: The next candidate(s) the study's sampler or optimiser asks for, given the evaluations stored so far. Deterministic and free of side effects; evaluate or record them, then call again. complete is true when the method has nothing more to ask.
tools.name: design_propose

tools.description: Definition, evaluation counts, best feasible record and Pareto front indices of a study.
tools.name: design_list_study

tools.description: Append one evaluated variant to a design ledger (a JSON-lines file in the sandbox, created on first use): named parameters and metrics with units, evaluator id and version, geometry/mesh hash, settings, verdict (ok, diverged, constraint_rejected, not_evaluated; a located reason is required unless ok), fidelity tier. The solver version and a timestamp are stamped. Returns the entry index.

ledger.description: ledger file inside the sandbox, e.g. fan/ledger.jsonl

metrics.description: [{name, value, unit}]; value may be null when the verdict is not ok

settings.description: what is needed to re-run (case settings, overrides, operating point)

tools.name: design_ledger_append

tools.description: Read a design ledger: entries filtered by kind, verdict, study, evaluator and fidelity (paged), plus optionally the Pareto-optimal entries for [{metric, sense}], the best entry and running best-so-far trace for {metric, sense}, and the history of one parameter. Pareto and best use ok evaluation entries of one evaluator and tier with consistent units (filter first when the ledger mixes them). Torn or foreign lines are reported in skipped_lines.
tools.name: design_ledger_query

tools.description: Export the (filtered) entries of a design ledger to a CSV file (one column per parameter and metric with its unit; numbers round-trip exactly) or a JSON file inside the sandbox.
tools.name: design_ledger_export

tools.description: Compare the metrics of a re-run (done with the entry's evaluator, settings and parameters) with ledger entry index: per metric recorded, new, absolute difference and whether it is within atol + rtol |recorded| (defaults 0: bit-identical); units, missing metrics and the verdict are checked too.
tools.name: design_ledger_rerun_check

tools.description: Run a tolerance study (the library's uq::run) of a named evaluator, now rcfd.fan_rom (the reduced-order axial fan), and record it in a design ledger inside the sandbox: uncertain inputs with uniform, truncated normal or beta distributions, Monte Carlo or replicated Latin hypercube sampling with a stopping rule on the standard error, then per metric the mean, sd, SE, quantiles with intervals and standardised regression coefficients, and the probability of violating each requirement. Every sample is a ledger entry and one uq_summary closes the study. Bounded by max_design_evaluations; a study name the ledger already holds is refused.

evaluator_settings.description: for rcfd.fan_rom: {fan: {n_blades, r_hub, r_tip, tip_gap, family: naca4|circular_arc, sections: [{radius, chord, stagger (rad), camber, camber_pos}]}, model?: {n_strips, cl_max, cd_normal, friction, annulus_drag, secondary_drag, tip_cd}, condition: {rpm, rho, nu, system_k, system_l, c0, observer_r, observer_theta (rad), n_scan}} in SI units

ledger.description: ledger file inside the sandbox, e.g. fan/ledger.jsonl

name.description: study name (the study of the ledger entries); must be new in the ledger

params.description: [{name, unit, dist}]; for rcfd.fan_rom the names stagger_common_deg (deg), chord_rel (1), tip_gap_delta (m); dist is {type: uniform, lo, hi}, {type: normal, mean, sd, lo?, hi?} or {type: beta, a, b, lo, hi}

stop.description: {batch, max_samples, min_batches?, se_abs?, se_rel?, metrics?}: batches until the SE of the mean of every controlled metric is at most max(se_abs, se_rel |mean|), or max_samples

workers.description: concurrent evaluations (the result does not depend on it); default 1

tools.name: design_uq

tools.description: Estimate first-order and total Sobol sensitivity indices (the library's sensitivity::run) of a named evaluator, now rcfd.fan_rom (the reduced-order axial fan), and record the study in a design ledger inside the sandbox: independent uncertain inputs, the Monte Carlo design A, B, A_B^(i) at n (d + 2) evaluations, per metric the indices S and ST of every input with standard errors. Every evaluation is a ledger entry and one sobol_summary closes the study. Bounded by max_design_evaluations; a study name the ledger already holds is refused.

evaluator_settings.description: for rcfd.fan_rom: {fan: {n_blades, r_hub, r_tip, tip_gap, family: naca4|circular_arc, sections: [{radius, chord, stagger (rad), camber, camber_pos}]}, model?: {n_strips, cl_max, cd_normal, friction, annulus_drag, secondary_drag, tip_cd}, condition: {rpm, rho, nu, system_k, system_l, c0, observer_r, observer_theta (rad), n_scan}} in SI units

ledger.description: ledger file inside the sandbox, e.g. fan/ledger.jsonl

n.description: rows of each of the matrices A and B (at least 2); the study makes n (d + 2) evaluations for d inputs

name.description: study name (the study of the ledger entries); must be new in the ledger

params.description: [{name, unit, dist}]; for rcfd.fan_rom the names stagger_common_deg (deg), chord_rel (1), tip_gap_delta (m); dist is {type: uniform, lo, hi}, {type: normal, mean, sd, lo?, hi?} or {type: beta, a, b, lo, hi}

workers.description: concurrent evaluations (the result does not depend on it); default 1

tools.name: design_sobol

tools.description: Render a field as a PNG image (optionally with velocity vectors) and return it as an image content block.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: render_image

tools.description: The project folder: manifest, counts of cases, meshes, designs, notes and runs (by state), and the problems validate finds.
tools.name: project_info

tools.description: Runs of the project, oldest first, with state, step, time and numeric metrics; run folders that cannot be read are listed as skipped with the reason. Filter by state or case; paged (offset, limit; next_offset when more).
tools.name: list_runs

tools.description: One run: its record (case, created, solver version, settings), status (state, step, time, reason, exit code), the last residual line and the last events.
tools.name: run_status

tools.description: metrics.json (final report values) of one or more runs (at most 50).
tools.name: read_metrics

tools.description: Residual and monitor series of a run (residuals.<equation>, monitors.<name>, and, for runs with adaptive pressure correctors, correctors = the count of the step's final outer iteration and corrector_cap = the estimates so far that ended at the cap) against the step, each decimated to at most max_points (default 200) keeping first, last and every bucket's minimum and maximum. A result over the size budget is written to runs/<id>/mcp/ and returned as a path.
tools.name: read_residuals

tools.description: Minimum, maximum and mean (cell-volume weighted for cell fields) of a field stored in a run's field store (runs/<id>/fields), at a step or time (nearest, floor or linear in time); default the last snapshot.

field.description: stored field name (default store: ux, uy, uz, p)

pick.description: how a step or time is matched (default nearest; linear interpolates in time)

step.description: snapshot by step (with pick nearest or floor)

tools.name: field_summary

tools.description: PNG image of a stored cell field of a 2D case at a step or time (default the last snapshot), drawn by the CPU renderer of render_image. An image over the size budget is written to runs/<id>/renders/ and returned as a path.

field.description: stored field name (default store: ux, uy, uz, p)

pick.description: how a step or time is matched (default nearest; linear interpolates in time)

step.description: snapshot by step (with pick nearest or floor)

tools.name: render_field

tools.description: Metrics of 2 to 10 runs side by side with the differences to the first run, and each run's state and residual history length.
tools.name: compare_runs

tools.description: Project-relative paths created, changed or deleted since a change token. Call without since to get the current token; .rcfd/ is not watched.
tools.name: list_changes

tools.description: Text of a project file (a case, mesh recipe or note) with the hash of the whole file, which is the base_hash for edit_case and write_note. Read in pages of at most 32000 bytes (offset, limit; next_offset when more).
tools.name: read_project_file

tools.description: Set dotted settings (e.g. physics.nu, solver.max_iterations) in a .toml or .json case file. The edited case is validated as set_setting does; the file is replaced atomically only if valid and only if it still has base_hash (else error 1200 with the current hash). The changed lines are edited in place (comments kept) when possible. dry_run validates without writing.
tools.name: edit_case

tools.description: Create or replace a text file under notes/. Without base_hash the file must not exist yet; with it the file is replaced only if it still has that hash (else error 1200 with the current hash).
tools.name: write_note

tools.description: Queue a run of a project case with the project's run service and start the service if none is alive. set holds rcfd run --set overrides (path=value). Returns the run id.
tools.name: start_run

tools.description: Hold a run: a queued run is not launched, a running one stops between two steps.
tools.name: pause_run

tools.description: Release a held run.
tools.name: resume_run

tools.description: Cancel a run; a running solver stops cleanly and writes its results.
tools.name: cancel_run

tools.description: Wait until a run's state differs from from (default: its state now) or the run is finished, failed or cancelled, for at most timeout_s seconds (default 30, at most 60). Call again to keep waiting.
tools.name: wait_run

tools.description: Show a view in the Studio that has this project open (Claude's canvas). view is a view specification, in one of two forms: {version: 1, title?, layout?: {columns: 1-4}, panels: [1 to 8 panels]}, or {version: 1, run, title?, layout?} without panels, a view of a run that takes the layout of its case's category (the panels chosen for the category of the run's case). Each panel is {kind, title?} with, by kind: case {case: a file under cases/}, run {run}, field {run, field: a stored field, snapshot?: index, default the last}, mesh {mesh: an entry of list_meshes} or mesh {case} (the mesh of a case under cases/), plot {run} (the residuals), monitor {run, monitor: a name of the run's monitors.<name>} or monitor {case, monitor: a report of the case, reports.<name>} (followed in the case's newest run), table {runs: 1 to 10 run ids}, setting {case, setting: a dotted setting path of the case, as edit_case takes it} (its value, which read_view gives under settings), process {case} (the case's steps from its creation to its last result, which read_view gives as process; each step names the view of its state). Checked against the project first: an invalid view is refused (error 1003) with every key and reason in data.errors, and nothing changes. With no Studio open, error 1002 says so and nothing is written. Otherwise the view is written to .rcfd/views/current.json with one journal line (view_shown), which every open Studio reads from the change feed and shows with its own views; returns its id and how many Studios have the project open.

reason.description: why this change is made, in a short sentence (at most 500 characters): kept with it in the project journal (.rcfd/edits.jsonl), shown in the Studio and by read_feed

tools.name: show_view

tools.description: The view shown last in the Studio (show_view): its id, when and by whom it was shown, the reason, and the view specification; exists false when none was shown.
tools.name: read_view

tools.description: Write a view as one self-contained HTML page (no script, nothing fetched: the Studio's theme and styles inline, every picture inline SVG), with the values of the views it names and where each came from (the files read and their hashes, the engine version). view is a view specification as show_view takes it (a view {version: 1, run} is written as its category's layout); without view, the view shown last. out is the page's project-relative path exports/<name>.html (default exports/view-<id>.html). An invalid view or out is refused (error 1003) with every key and reason in data.errors, and nothing is written; no Studio need be open. Returns the page's id, path, hash and size in bytes; one journal line (view_exported).

reason.description: why this change is made, in a short sentence (at most 500 characters): kept with it in the project journal (.rcfd/edits.jsonl), shown in the Studio and by read_feed

view.description: the view specification (version 1); default the view shown last

tools.name: export_view

tools.description: A derived picture of a stored snapshot of a run (default the last) as a GLB file in runs/<id>/derived/ (metres; POSITION, _CELL the cell of each vertex, _VALUE, _TRIANGLE): kind iso (the surface where a cell field equals level, marching tetrahedra; colour_by another field), streamlines (RK4 from seeds through the velocity ux, uy, uz, linear over tets), slice (the cells cut by an axis plane, a value per triangle; vectors adds each triangle's stored vector) or cut_surface (the Studio's picture: the boundary surface on the kept side of an axis plane, with vectors its arrows). Fields are the stored cell fields and speed. The same arguments give the same file, which is reused; rcfd post derive makes it without a project.

at.description: slice, cut_surface: the plane's coordinate, m

axis.description: slice, cut_surface: the plane's normal axis

colour_by.description: iso: the field coloured on the surface (default the level)

field.description: a stored cell field or speed (iso, slice; cut_surface colours by it)

level.description: iso: the value of the surface, inside the field's range

max_length.description: streamlines: arc length per line, m (default 4 x the bounding box diagonal)

min_speed.description: streamlines: a line stops below this speed (default 1e-9 x the largest)

seeds.description: streamlines: {rake: {p0, p1, n}}, {points: [[x, y, z], ...]} or {patch: name, n}; at most 1000 seeds

snapshot.description: snapshot index (or step or time, the nearest)

step_fraction.description: streamlines: the RK4 step as a part of the cell length (default 0.25)

vectors.description: slice, cut_surface: add the vectors (arrows for cut_surface)

tools.name: derive_picture

tools.description: The project's change feed: who changed what and why. Each entry is a line of the project journal (an edit with its actor, command, changed settings with old and new values, and reason; a case created, a mesh imported, a run submitted, paused, resumed or cancelled), a run's state change, warning or stop, or a file changed outside the workspace (external, path only). Call without since to get the current cursor; with since, the entries numbered after it, oldest first (limit, default 50; next to continue).

from_seq.description: instead of since: replay the project journal from this seq on (1 for all of it), also what happened before this server started; entries carry no n; next_seq continues, and since = cursor continues live

tools.name: read_feed

tools.description: The hash of a project file or folder, by the rule of run.json mesh_hash: a file is fnv64 of its bytes; a folder (an OpenFOAM mesh) is fnv64 over the sorted lines <relative path>\0<file hash>\n of every file below it. Symbolic links are refused; at most 4 GiB and 100000 files (error 1003 names the limit). Compare with run.json mesh_hash to see whether a run's mesh changed since.
tools.name: hash_project_file

tools.description: Create a new case file cases/<name>.toml (or .json) in the project from exactly one source: a shipped example (byte for byte, with the data files it reads), a built-in template, TOML text, a settings object (written as JSON) or a copy of a project case. The case is validated before anything is written and no file is ever replaced. Returns its path and hash (the base_hash for edit_case).

copy.description: project-relative case file to copy byte for byte

example.description: a shipped example, written byte for byte with the data files it reads

name.description: case name: letters, digits, '-' and '_', at most 64 characters, not taken in cases/ in any letter case; the file is cases/<name>.toml (.json for settings or a .json source)

reason.description: why this change is made, in a short sentence (at most 500 characters): kept with it in the project journal (.rcfd/edits.jsonl), shown in the Studio and by read_feed

settings.description: case settings as JSON, written as cases/<name>.json

tools.name: new_case

tools.description: Build a project case's mesh as its settings describe it (a generator, or mesh.file with mesh.scale and mesh.transform) and return the quality report of rcfd check-mesh and the boundary patches, whose names boundaries.* must use. The mesh file must be in the project folder. Change mesh settings with edit_case, which checks the edited mesh too.

case.description: project-relative case file (.toml or .json), e.g. cases/cavity.toml

tools.name: check_case_mesh

tools.description: PNG image of a project case's mesh coloured by a cell-quality measure (default non_orthogonality, the largest of the cell's faces, degrees), drawn by the CPU renderer of render_field: the cells cut by a plane, by default the middle of the thinnest direction (a 2D case face on). Colours run from the ideal value up to the largest value. An image over the size budget is drawn narrower.

case.description: project-relative case file (.toml or .json), e.g. cases/cavity.toml

slice.description: coordinate of the plane along axis (default the middle)

tools.name: preview_mesh

tools.description: Bring a mesh that is in the project folder into meshes/: a Gmsh or Fluent .msh/.cas file, or an OpenFOAM polyMesh folder. It is read with the solver's readers first (cells, faces, patches, zones and bounds are returned), then copied to meshes/<name> without replacing anything. Point a case at it with edit_case: mesh.source = "file" and mesh.file = the returned mesh_file.

name.description: name in meshes/ (default the source's name; a file keeps its extension)

path.description: project-relative mesh file or OpenFOAM folder

reason.description: why this change is made, in a short sentence (at most 500 characters): kept with it in the project journal (.rcfd/edits.jsonl), shown in the Studio and by read_feed

tools.name: import_mesh

tools.description: Meshes under meshes/ (files, and OpenFOAM folders as one entry) with their size and the project cases whose mesh.file names each one; also case mesh files that are not in meshes/ and cases that could not be read. Paged (offset, limit; next_offset when more).
tools.name: list_meshes

tools.description: The run service's budgets: .rcfd/runner-config.json (exists, hash: the base_hash for set_runner_config, values, problem: why the runner would refuse the file), the runner's defaults on this machine, and in_use: the values the runner running now started with. The runner reads the file when it starts (applies: next_start).
tools.name: runner_config

tools.description: Change the run service's budgets in .rcfd/runner-config.json (max_runs, cpu_threads, mem_budget_mb, mem_base_mb, mem_kb_per_cell, poll_ms, adopt_probe_ms, cancel_grace_ms): a number sets a key, null removes it (the runner's default). Checked as the runner checks the file (error 1003 at the key) and written atomically only if the file still has base_hash (null: there is no file yet; else error 1200 with the current hash). A file the runner cannot read is replaced only with replace: true and every key given. Applies at the next runner start; the runner is not restarted. Returns the budgets as runner_config does.

base_hash.description: hash from runner_config; null when there is no file

reason.description: why this change is made, in a short sentence (at most 500 characters): kept with it in the project journal (.rcfd/edits.jsonl), shown in the Studio and by read_feed

replace.description: write exactly set (every key) over a file the runner cannot read

set.description: {key: number, or null for the runner's default}

tools.name: set_runner_config

tools.description: What a project case's time step depends on, without running it (ADR 0737): the kind of run, solver.dt and solver.end_time (and whether the file sets them), its own step control, cells, 2D, bounds, the thinnest and thickest cell (h_min, h_max, m), the fastest speed at the start (u0, m/s, and where), the pressure correctors; run_time: the plan of a run with the run_time settings of start_run (default: automatic step at Courant 0.5, adaptive correctors), its --set entries, first step, step and Courant estimates and a warning above Courant 2; memory: the runner's estimate with the project's budgets. Error 1003 when the case does not build.

run_time.description: set the run's time step: solver.end_time = simulate_s (default the case's), a first step for the courant target (default 0.5) through the thinnest cell, then the solver's Courant controller up to max_dt (default simulate_s/100) (mode adaptive, the default), equal steps (fixed) or the case's own (case); adaptive_correctors (default true) adds solver.corrector_control=adaptive where the solver accepts it. Entries go before the store plan's and set's.

tools.name: case_facts

tools.description: Refine x2 (ADR 0737): double every cell count of the case's generator mesh (mesh.nx, mesh.ny, mesh.nz and the second block's _right counts), written through edit_case's rule (only if the file still has base_hash, else error 1200; comments kept).
